meta.name: github
meta.description: Interact with GitHub using the `gh` CLI. Use `gh issue`, `gh pr`, `gh run`, and `gh api` for issues, PRs, CI runs, and advanced queries.

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理 GitHub 仓库、议题和 CI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在终端操作 GitHub 上的开发流程
copy.tagline_en: Manage GitHub repos, issues, and CI from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage GitHub workflows from the terminal

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 gh 命令行工具操作 GitHub，包括查看和管理 Issue、Pull Request、CI 运行，以及执行高级 API 查询。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 查看或管理 GitHub 上的 Issue、PR、CI 运行，或执行自定义 API 查询时触发。

say.text: 查看仓库 owner/repo 的 PR #55 的 CI 状态。
say.note: Claude 会运行 gh pr checks 命令。

say.text: 列出 owner/repo 最近 10 次工作流运行。
say.note: Claude 会运行 gh run list 命令。

say.text: 用 API 获取 owner/repo 的 PR #55 的标题和状态。
say.note: Claude 会运行 gh api 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can interact with GitHub via the `gh` CLI, including viewing and managing Issues, Pull Requests, CI runs, and executing advanced API queries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to view or manage GitHub Issues, PRs, CI runs, or perform custom API queries.

say_en.text: Check CI status of PR #55 in owner/repo.
List the last 10 workflow runs in owner/repo.
Get title and state of PR #55 in owner/repo via API.
